Dear Mr. Smith,

Thank you for following up, and I apologise for the delay in getting back to you.

For your new office, the bundle we would propose is our Business Laptop package: 14-inch laptops with docking stations, a second monitor per desk and a three-year support plan. Each laptop is set up with your software licences before delivery, so your staff can start on the first day. The support plan includes next-business-day replacement and a help desk that your team can reach by email or chat. If you later need more seats, they can be added to the same plan.

To prepare an accurate quotation for your management, could you tell us:
1. Roughly how many staff will need a laptop, and how many of them also need a second monitor?
2. Which software licences should be installed, and do you already have an IT support contract we should work alongside?

If your team would like to try a laptop in the meantime, we can lend you a demo unit for 14 days.

Once we have your answers, we will send the quotation, and we would be glad to arrange a short walkthrough whenever it suits you.

Best regards,

Hi John,

As mentioned on WhatsApp, here is an overview for Globex Corp.

BUNDLES THAT FIT WHAT YOU DESCRIBED
- Business Laptop: 14-inch laptop, docking station and the software licences you choose, set up before delivery.
- Dual Monitor kit: two 24-inch monitors with stands and cables for each desk.
- Warehouse tablets: this is not a standard plan. We would first review it with your IT team before committing to anything.

LIST PRICES (USD)

Option A: one-time purchase (hardware with 12 months of support included)
- Starter, up to 10 seats: Business Laptop 9,900 / with Dual Monitor kit 12,900
- Team, up to 25 seats: Business Laptop 23,900 / with Dual Monitor kit 30,900
- Office, up to 50 seats: Business Laptop 46,900 / with Dual Monitor kit 59,900

Option B: subscription
- Per seat per month, billed annually, 12-month minimum: Business Laptop 39 / with Dual Monitor kit 49
- Under this option the docking stations are purchased separately. We will include them in your proposal.

ROLLING OUT ACROSS OFFICES
Where an office has no IT staff on site, each laptop is shipped ready to use and set up in about 15 minutes, with no IT visit needed. Each office has its own asset list, and the data can be exported for company-wide reporting. Where offices are managed centrally, the laptops can be enrolled in your existing device management instead.

INTEGRATION
Asset and support records can be pushed to external systems through REST API and webhooks, so tickets can feed into your central help desk. Reports can be exported as CSV or PDF. We will send the setup documents in a separate email.

NEXT STEP
We would like to cover reseller terms on a call with our Owner. If you can share how many offices and seats you expect in the first phase, we can prepare a proper proposal ahead of that call.

Best regards,

Dear Mr. Smith,

Thank you for the detailed requirements. I am sorry we did not confirm the meeting times you suggested for 11 and 12 October.

From what you shared (around 100 staff, two floors, existing monitors on some desks, one training room and an IT help desk), we are designing a complete setup for your office. It covers laptops for every member of staff, second monitors where they are missing, a shared set for the training room, software licences and a support plan. Our proposal will set out the purchase options (annual subscription or one-time purchase), any accessories needed, delivery, setup and ongoing support.

So that the design and the quotation fit your office, could you help us with the following:

1. Location: in which city and country is the office?
2. Staff: how many people work at a desk, and how many work mostly away from the office?
3. Monitors: which desks already have a monitor, and of what size and connection type?
4. Software: which software licences are needed, and are any already owned by your company?
5. Training room: how many seats, and should the laptops there be shared or assigned?
6. Accessories: do you need docking stations, headsets or bags?
7. IT: who looks after your computers today, and should our support plan work alongside them?
8. Reports: which asset and support reports do you need, for example monthly ticket summaries?
9. Delivery: should the laptops arrive set up and labelled, or will your team set them up?
10. Timeline: when would you like everything in place, and who else in your team will take part in the decision?

If it is easier to go through these together, we would be glad to have a short Google Meet. Please send two or three times this week that suit you and we will confirm one.

Best regards,

It covers a laptop for every member of staff, a second monitor where needed, a shared set for the training room, reports, and the connection with your help desk.

To prepare an accurate quotation for hardware, licences, setup and support, we need a few details:

Your office
1. In which city and country is the office? Is it the only site, or are more planned?
2. What are your working hours, and roughly how many people join each month?

Desks and monitors
3. Which desks already have a monitor, and what size and connection type are they?

5. Do some staff share desks, and should their laptops be identical?

Software

Training room

Support

9. Do you need next-business-day replacement for every seat or only for some?

IT and reports

Delivery and licensing
11. Should the laptops arrive set up and labelled, or will your team set them up?
12. How long should the support plan run, and in which language should the help desk answer?
13. Do you prefer a one-time purchase or an annual subscription, and when would you like everything in place?

We would be glad to meet on Google Meet to go through these together. Could you share two or three times that suit you between 9:00 and 13:00 your time (13:00 to 17:00 Japan time)?

Best regards,
